caption: A construction worker uses a suction cup to lift a heavy glass panel with a small picture adhered to it; the picture remains affixed.
conditions: first frame, caption, existing requirements; no future target
physical_dependency_analysis:
OBSERVED: Worker crouches, holds suction cup against glass panel with picture; panel remains fixed to frame.
RESPONSE: Suction cup seals via atmospheric pressure, counteracting gravity to lift panel.
PERSISTENCE: Seal integrity and controlled force maintain lift; picture adheres due to surface tension and adhesion.
CHANGE: Weaker seal or unbalanced force risks detachment; picture may peel if pressure exceeds adhesive limit.
